action: Name an accountable sponsor, choose one cross-functional workflow and pilot roles, confirm resources and employee communication
deliverable_or_measure: Approved pilot scope, named owners, eligible population and measurement plan
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Baseline and capacity decision by Day 7
dependency_or_limit: No organisational approval/resource commitment has yet been supplied

proposed_responsible_roles: Managers of both sides of the workflow
action: Map one real handover path, required information, receiving owner, urgency rules, escalation and rework; collect a baseline
deliverable_or_measure: Workflow map and 14-day handover log; issue causes verified against work examples
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Agree workflow-specific response expectations by Day 14
dependency_or_limit: Do not assume which department pair causes delays from the survey

action: Pilot a simple handover checklist, receiving acknowledgement, shared status and escalation route
deliverable_or_measure: All in-scope handovers have defined information, accountable recipient and backup
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Proposed standard: 100% of in-scope handover types documented by Day 30
dependency_or_limit: Reuse an existing tool where possible; purchase of a new platform is not assumed

action: Review delayed/reworked handovers weekly, fix the recurring obstacle and check that tracking is not adding excessive admin
deliverable_or_measure: Handover completeness, agreed-SLA performance, rework and burden review
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Proposed pilot standard: ≥95% required-field completeness; efficiency target agreed from the Day-14 baseline
dependency_or_limit: Targets are proposed design choices, not predicted survey effects

action: Review existing appraisal, progression and reward criteria against how decisions are explained; listen to contrasting employee experiences
deliverable_or_measure: Inventory of criteria, gaps, review/appeal route and eligible pilot roles
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Agree what can be clarified now and what requires policy review by Day 14
dependency_or_limit: No claim that every decision is unfair; retain no-concern experiences

action: Publish understandable criteria for pilot roles, brief eligible employees and state how to seek clarification or review
deliverable_or_measure: Versioned criteria and accessible explanation/review route
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Proposed standard: criteria/explanation available for 100% of pilot roles by Day 30
dependency_or_limit: Do not announce promotion/pay promises or bypass existing decision authority

action: Review a defined set of pilot decisions for documented criteria, explanation and consistent application; correct verified gaps
deliverable_or_measure: Decision-review log with exceptions and follow-up; no names in presentation outputs
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Proposed standard: every reviewed decision has a documented reason and identified owner; report exceptions openly in aggregate
dependency_or_limit: Documentation is evidence of process completion, not proof that employees perceive fairness

action: Offer each pilot employee a specific feedback conversation and explain non-monetary recognition criteria; review access across roles
deliverable_or_measure: Feedback offered/completed/declined counts and recognition-access review
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Proposed standard: every eligible pilot employee offered a feedback conversation each 30-day cycle
dependency_or_limit: No quota of awards or forced praise; monetary decisions stay with existing approval processes

action: Document critical task owners and backup, priorities, leave coverage and legitimate escalation needs outside normal hours
deliverable_or_measure: Critical-task/backup register and communicated escalation expectations
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Proposed standard: 100% of agreed critical tasks have primary, backup and escalation owners by Day 30
dependency_or_limit: The survey does not measure actual workload volume or diagnose burnout

action: Create a simple concern/action log, acknowledge normal concerns, assign an owner and update employees on progress and closure
deliverable_or_measure: Owner, acknowledgement, next update, resolution status and employee closure feedback
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Proposed normal-concern standards: acknowledge within 2 business days; owner and next-update date within 5; sensitive/urgent matters follow existing routes
dependency_or_limit: Do not promise all problems are resolved within five days; aggregate reports exclude identifying details

proposed_accountable_owner: HR lead / Administration or IT head by issue
action: Confidentially verify facilities/equipment and respectful-treatment/time-boundary accounts, triage confirmed issues and route them appropriately
deliverable_or_measure: Verification status, responsible function, action date and follow-up; aggregate reporting only
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Initial triage in the first week; remediation dates depend on verified urgency, scope and resources
dependency_or_limit: Employee accounts are not established incidents; broad theme counts are not incident prevalence

action: Check pilot readiness, process coverage, workload burden and unresolved verification issues
deliverable_or_measure: Continue/adapt decision with owners and next review date
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Proceed only with usable baseline, assigned owners and feasible operating standards
dependency_or_limit: An attractive dashboard does not replace implementation

action: Repeat the selected exact questions, report valid n/category shares and respondent composition, compare operational measures and listen to examples of actual change
deliverable_or_measure: Baseline/follow-up comparison with denominators, participation, limitations and strengths guardrails
proposed_standard_or_decision_gate: Set outcome targets by Day 14; assess at Days 60/90; decide scale, adapt or stop at Day 90
dependency_or_limit: Before/after change alone does not establish causality; no employee-level attrition prediction
